zh: 优化 iOS 自动化打包发布机制：在云端构建流水线中加入 Apple 开发者证书智能自动清理功能，构建前自动巡检并清理 CI 临时证书，彻底解决证书配额占满导致的构建中断。
移动端多图卡片滑动交互重构：全面优化 iOS 与 Android 端多图层叠轮播交互，实现自然的滑出飞行过渡与轻量触感反馈，彻底消除滑动切换时图片弹回原位的视觉错觉。
移动端会话列表支持长按置顶与多端同步：长按或点击操作菜单即可一键置顶/取消置顶，置顶会话聚合展示在专区顶部，与 Web 端及桌面端实时双向云同步。
en: Optimize iOS automated release pipeline: introduce automated Apple development certificate pruning before builds, revoking stale ephemeral CI certificates to prevent quota exhaustion.
Refactor mobile stacked image deck swipe physics: implement smooth continuous flight dismissal and subtle haptic feedback across iOS and Android, eliminating the return illusion on card drag.
Support conversation pinning and multi-device cloud synchronization: long-press or tap action menu to pin/unpin conversations to the top section, kept in continuous sync with Web and Desktop.
